title: What to expect from NFL's second-year QBs in 2026, from Cam Ward to Shedeur Sanders

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: What to expect from NFL's second-year QBs in 2026, from Cam Ward to Shedeur Sanders
sources.description: Expect Ward to take a noticeable second-year leap, even if he doesn’t suddenly become elite. As for Sanders, he showed enough to compete for a backup job, but unless he can overcome his processing and physical limitations, he’s unlikely to develop into a starter.
